trust_decision.summary: The 4-bit RTP media-header frame_count sent by the remote A2DP source is used as a divisor for the per-frame length in the LC3plus decoder thread without checking it is non-zero.

landing_point.why: The summary names the LC3plus decoder and division-by-zero. The only division by a packet field in a2dp_lc3plus_dec_thread is this one.

fix_sites.entry_point: Inbound A2DP media packets on an LC3plus sink transport, read by io_poll_and_read_bt into a2dp_lc3plus_dec_thread (src/a2dp-lc3plus.c:481)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None needed. No other route divides by frame_count: the SBC and LDAC decoders use it only as a loop count (src/a2dp-sbc.c:370-371, src/a2dp-ldac.c:363-364), and the LHDC decoder does not read it (src/a2dp-lhdc.c:489-494).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Fragmented transfer: non-last fragments must still be buffered and reassembled, and the first fragment's frame_count sizes the reassembly buffer. A check that drops any packet with frame_count==0 before reassembly, or rejects fragmented packets, would break legitimate streams. Packet-loss concealment for missing frames (lc3plus_dec24 with len 0) must also keep working.

O6_input_shapes: last fragment of a fragmented packet with frame_count==0

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An LDAC decoder that splits rtp_payload_len evenly by frame_count, as LC3plus does.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same RTP media header and same decode-loop structure; a maintainer could copy the LC3plus frame-length idiom across.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Reassembly buffer sized by dividing by the first fragment's frame_count instead of multiplying.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same field drives the buffer sizing next to the sink. It is a plausible variant, but still WHERE-type.

O9_family: CWE-369 divide-by-zero on an untrusted packet header field (numeric)

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (configure.ac) + gcc; LC3plus is an optional external library (--enable-lc3plus, configure.ac:197-206) that must be supplied separately; also needs BlueZ, D-Bus and GLib development headers
services: D-Bus (the test harness uses a test D-Bus manager)
O10_build.project_tests: test/test-io.c:1278-1301 has an LC3plus encode/decode round-trip; the fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (frame_count == 0) continue;` right before the division without calling ffb_rewind(&bt_payload), so stale reassembled payload stays in the buffer; the published fix calls ffb_rewind (fix.diff:31).

out_of_scope_notes: src/a2dp-lc3plus.c:571: when frame_count exceeds the payload bytes, the frame length rounds down to 0 and every frame is decoded as loss concealment. This is not a crash and is unrelated to the advisory's divide-by-zero.
unverified: Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell). The source tree looks small, so tiny_repo (<5 MB) probably holds, but it is not listed in red flags.
Not checked whether the external LC3plus library tolerates lc3plus_dec24 with a zero length on the normal path.
